name: s16_struggle_mega
purpose: A Pokemon that must Struggle cannot Mega Evolve: Raichu holds Raichunite Y but knows only Fake Out, which Champions disables after its first move action; from turn 2 its request offers only Struggle and no Mega (sim/pokemon.ts getMoveRequestData), and a typed mega is dropped with it (sim/side.ts chooseMove). The side's Mega stays available: Charizard Mega Evolves in the same choice in turn 3.
